01What is AQERYO?+

02Is this a subscription?+

The offers shown on this page are one-time digital purchases. Your checkout and delivery terms should match the product you are actually selling.

03Does the bundle include resale rights?+

Resale rights apply to the Reseller Plan only where the licensed source bundle grants those rights. Verify the license before making resale claims.

04Can I use it on mobile?+

Yes. The page is responsive and designed for desktop, tablet and mobile screens.

05How do I receive access?+

After payment, connect the purchase button to your delivery or checkout system so the buyer receives the correct access instructions.

06Can I change the price or checkout link?+

Yes. The plan prices and checkout URLs are controlled directly in the page markup and can be changed before launch.
